# Mapping Business Model

## Core principle

Mapping business model within product lifecycle boundaries. Deterministic checks own scope, typed preconditions, evidence, and coverage; the agent performs only the domain judgment that cannot be encoded safely.

## Do not activate when

- the requested outcome does not require mapping business model within product lifecycle boundaries
- the typed inputs for mapping-business-model are absent and another technique owns the outcome
